title: Project settings apiKeyHelper runs before trust in claude -p
reason_not_testable: The helper runs as a settings-driven process outside tool dispatch, so no PreToolUse or PostToolUse hook sees it. The e2e format asserts only on recorded tool_response values and the final reply, so the required check (canary file not created, no credential file read) cannot be expressed. Covered by non-hook controls: Claude Code trust behaviour (UNVERIFIED for the current version) and a policy against running claude -p in untrusted clones.
